newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper ends firmer, LME stock drop expected.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper ends firmer, LME stock drop expected.

text.p: COMEX copper ended firmer Thursday as a stronger tone and upward move begun in the previous session continued modestly ahead of an expected draw in LME stocks on Friday.
Dealers expected stocks to fall 2,000 to 4,000 tonnes Friday in keeping with the regular pattern of small dips established in past weeks.
"Good demand numbers continue to filter out and there is a little bit of technical buying - it looks good on the charts," Fred Demler of E D and F Man International said.
May COMEX settled 1.70 cents firmer at 110.50 cents, traded 110.80 to 109.20 cents. Spot March went out 2.60 cents firmer at 115.50 cents.
Volume was estimated at 13,000 lots compared to Wednesday's official 18,022 lots.

Earlier William O'Neill of Merrill Lynch said Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's clearest warning yet of a possible rate hike would not do anything to halt copper's advance because a rise next week or in May had already been anticipated by brokers.
The backwardation on LME firmed slightly to end at $40-$43, up some $5 on the day.
